summary.note: Smoke scope only -- Upgrade/Manage buttons on the 3 paid plan cards were NOT clicked (would POST to /api/billing/checkout and redirect to a real Stripe-hosted checkout page); their navigation targets are documented via source-code read in conditionalElements above, not verified live.

keyFindings: No login wall encountered; page rendered fully server-authenticated as expected.

Tested account is free-tier / no active subscription: all 3 paid plan cards (Starter/Individual/Team) render 'Upgrade' CTA; none show the 'Your plan' current-plan badge. Team card correctly shows 'Most Popular' badge.

Enterprise 'Contact us' button correctly navigates (client-side router.push) to /billing/plans/contact, which renders a lead-capture form (first/last name, company, work email, phone, role dropdown, Submit) -- NOT a payment flow, confirmed safe.

Per source (handleSubscribe in page.tsx): clicking 'Upgrade' on a paid plan card POSTs to /api/billing/checkout and, on success, does `window.location.href = <Stripe checkout URL>` (external redirect) -- NOT clicked live per task instructions to avoid a real checkout flow. On a 409 (already subscribed) it instead calls redirectToPortal('home').

CreditPackSection 'Buy' button is correctly disabled until a pack tile ($99/$199/$399) is selected; selecting a tile live-toggled aria-pressed and enabled 'Buy' as expected from source. 'Buy' was not clicked (would POST /api/billing/pack/checkout -> real Stripe redirect).

No data-testid attributes exist anywhere in PlansPage / EnterpriseCard / CreditPackSection source -- downstream Playwright locators should use getByRole+name scoped by nearest heading/article/region text, not CSS classes (all decorative classes are Tailwind utility classes per source read).
No bugs, crashes, dead redirects, or error states observed. Page is stable and matches source-code-derived expectations exactly.

Re-verified live via a second CDP pass: navigated fresh, confirmed S0 (Starter/Individual/Team all 'Upgrade', Team 'Most Popular', no 'Your plan' badge, no past-due Alert), clicked '$199 Popular 6,000 Credits' pack tile -> Buy button enabled (S2), clicked Enterprise 'Contact us' -> landed on /billing/plans/contact lead-capture form (S1), navigated back -> page reset cleanly to S0 (Buy disabled again). All results identical to the prior run; no drift or regressions found.
